channel.title: The Colorado Sun - Article Feed
channel.description: Latest articles from The Colorado Sun (coloradosun.com)

item.title: Can you be fined for walking your dog off leash in Denver?
item.description: Yes. People who walk their dogs off leash outside of designated areas in Denver such as dog parks could face hundreds of dollars in fines.

item.title: Child care providers fight headwinds on Colorado’s rural Eastern Plains, with staff in short supply
item.description: Child care providers are fighting headwinds on Colorado’s rural Eastern Plains, with staff in short supply — but a new center is attracting parents from as far away as western Kansas.

item.title: Colorado Democrats propose state rules for federal tax credit scholarship program, worrying it could lead to vouchers
item.description: Colorado lawmakers who oppose the federal program want to set up regulations that would reinforce nondiscrimination, transparency and accountability

item.title: Colorado is about to refund $300M to taxpayers that it may not have to
item.description: Gov. Jared Polis has called on the legislature to recover the money by reducing future TABOR refunds. But state officials are divided over whether they can legally do so.

item.title: To patch its budget hole, Colorado is proposing cuts to medical education. Hospitals say that’s a big mistake.
item.description: The proposed cuts would save Colorado about $14 million a year in funding that helps hospitals teach doctors in training

item.title: Colorado wants help picking a name for Front Range passenger train ahead of November vote to fund route
item.description: The district wants to settle on a name before deciding whether to put a measure on the ballot that would increase sales taxes along the Front Range

item.title: Fort Carson soldier identified as 7th U.S. service member killed in Iran war
item.description: Sgt. Benjamin Pennington, 26, of Kentucky, was assigned to the Colorado Springs Army post in June 2025

item.title: Effort to eliminate criminal penalties for prostitution in Colorado will be abandoned
item.description: State Sen. Nick Hinrichsen, a Pueblo Democrat and main sponsor of Senate Bill 97, said the measure doesn’t have enough support to clear the Senate Judiciary Committee — its first hurdle

item.title: Energy Secretary Chris Wright, during Colorado stop, warns that high gas prices could last weeks
item.description: Wright said the US will insure oil tankers traveling through the Strait of Hormuz and will even use the military to escort ships

item.title: Nearly 3,800 JBS unionized meatpackers in Greeley plan to strike March 16
item.description: They’ve been working on an expired contract for eight months. JBS officials accused the union of not sharing the company’s latest offer with workers.
